title: Redesigning a water purifier
body: Sales of AquaPure, a water purifier made by Neer Appliances Ltd., have fallen for three quarters. The chief executive officer and the board study the market and decide that the product must be redesigned with a cheaper filter and a smart display, and they set the strategy and budget for the change. The production manager then interprets this decision for his department: he arranges for engineers to be trained on the new design, assigns duties to each section and works with the marketing department on a launch date. On the shop floor, the foremen explain the new assembly steps to the workers, check the quality of each unit and make sure that materials are not wasted and safety rules are followed.

title: Confusion at Sanjeevani Hospital
body: Sanjeevani Hospital prepares detailed annual plans, has a clear organisation structure with separate departments for admissions, pathology, pharmacy and wards, employs well-trained supervisors and has a monthly control report. Each department works sincerely and its staff are willing to help. Yet patients complain that test reports reach the wards late, that two departments sometimes order the same medicines while other medicines run out, and that discharge is delayed because the pharmacy and the billing section work on different timings. The administrator observes that every department is doing its own work well, but the activities of different departments do not fit together in time and sequence.
